nodes.description: FDX2 supplies electrons for de novo [2Fe-2S] cluster synthesis on the ISCU2 scaffold and again for reductive fusion of [2Fe-2S] clusters into [4Fe-4S] clusters on ISCA1-ISCA2-IBA57. Partial FDX2 deficiency therefore lowers maturation of both [2Fe-2S] and [4Fe-4S] mitochondrial proteins. Cell-culture knockdown studies agree that FDX2 is required for Fe-S protein biogenesis; whether FDX1 also contributes is debated, which may bear on how much residual Fe-S assembly patient tissues retain.
